method: Typed AST comparison: mapping keys are literal String/InsertName values, including Null and Off. global.types duplicate definitions reduce to final HashMap insertions and only global type-entry order is ignored. All remaining mapping/sequence and struct/enum order is retained. Scalar type spellings remain strings; unquoted null shape values remain unit payloads, and null spec bounds remain Option<u64>::None. This models legacy typed deserialization, not generic YAML scalar coercion.
sourceSemantics: scale-info-legacy/src/chain_types.rs DeserializableChainTypes.types is HashMap<InsertName,DeserializableShape>; repeated map entries replace earlier values.
